presets.link-fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
presets.not-you: If this was not you, secure your account now.

verify-email.subject: Confirm your e-mail address
verify-email.preheader: One click to confirm your address.
verify-email.title: Confirm your e-mail address
verify-email.body: Confirm that this address is yours to finish setting up your {brand} account.

reset-password.subject: Reset your password
reset-password.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.
reset-password.title: Reset your password
reset-password.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your {brand} account. Choose a new one with the button below.

password-changed.subject: Your password was changed
password-changed.preheader: The password of your account was just changed.
password-changed.title: Your password was changed
password-changed.body: The password of your {brand} account was just changed.

email-changed.subject: Your e-mail address was changed
email-changed.preheader: Your account now signs in with a new address.
email-changed.title: Your e-mail address was changed
email-changed.body: Your {brand} account now uses {newEmail}. We send this notice to your former address.

sign-in-code.subject: Your sign-in code: {code}
sign-in-code.preheader: Enter this code to sign in.
sign-in-code.title: Your sign-in code
sign-in-code.body: Enter this code to sign in to {brand}. It works once.
sign-in-code.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this e-mail: no one can sign in without the code.

magic-link.subject: Your sign-in link
magic-link.title: Sign in to {brand}
magic-link.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link works once.

new-sign-in.subject: New sign-in to your account
new-sign-in.preheader: Your account was signed in from a new device.
new-sign-in.title: New sign-in to your account
new-sign-in.banner: Your account was signed in from a device we had not seen.
new-sign-in.body: If this was you, there is nothing to do.

welcome.subject: Welcome, {name}
welcome.title: Welcome to {brand}
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Everything you need is one click away.
